summary: Comprehensive testing of Timer CasparCG OSC pipeline. Backend: 5/5 pytest passed covering GET /api/status shape, idle detection (IDLE_TIMEOUT=2s), OSC->status pipeline with test_osc_sender.py, LIVE handling (total<=0), and WebSocket /api/ws streaming. Frontend: all required data-testids present, wall-clock updating, correct filenames rendered for both channels, MM:SS format enforced, red warning color triggered at <=10s on CH2. End-to-end integration via public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (WSS through ingress) verified.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); consider migrating to lifespan handler in future.

test_osc_sender.py inside /app/backend has prefix 'test_' which pytest will auto-collect if placed in tests dir; currently safe since it lives outside tests/, but rename recommended (e.g., osc_sim.py) to avoid future collection surprises.
MongoDB client is instantiated but unused; consider removing to reduce startup surface until settings page is added.
WebSocket endpoint blocks on ws.receive_text() while broadcast_loop pushes frames; works but if a client never sends, the loop is fine. Just note: no keepalive/ping handling from server side.
seed_data_creation: None. OSC packets simulated on demand via /app/backend/test_osc_sender.py.
context_for_next_testing_agent: OSC sender at /app/backend/test_osc_sender.py streams ch1=45s and ch2=20s loops; kill/timeout after use to allow idle transition (2s). WS endpoint is /api/ws (wss via ingress). Public URL for FE + API-through-ingress: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. All required data-testids: timer-display, wall-clock, connection-status, channel-panel-{ch1,ch2}, channel-timeleft-{ch1,ch2}, channel-filename-{ch1,ch2}.
